initial_decision.brief_rationale: The population table establishes an observed risk difference of -0.10, but supplies no causal identification assumptions. Request the archived design record R293-2 to assess whether the causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The design record supplies consistency and no interference but no condition identifying the causal effect from observed training access. The descriptive risk difference is -0.10; the requested average causal risk difference is not uniquely determined.
